metadata.sourceAgency: NJ Department of Education & Parsippany-Troy Hills Township Schools Business Office

revenueSources.description: Portion paid directly by Parsippany residential and commercial property owners (64.1% of your total property tax bill)

revenueSources.source: State Education Aid (Categorical Special Ed, Transportation, Security)
revenueSources.description: State of New Jersey SFRA formula aid (covers less than 10% of PTHSD's total budget, leaving 86.4% on local property taxpayers)

revenueSources.source: Fund Balance / Surplus & Capital Reserve Withdrawal
revenueSources.description: Audited prior-year fund balance, tuition, and student activity/parking fees
Federal special education (IDEA) and ESEA entitlement grants

majorAppropriations.details: Salaries for general education teachers across 10 elementary schools, Brooklawn & Central Middle Schools, and Parsippany High & Parsippany Hills High Schools, plus STEM/AP materials and 1:1 devices.
Medical, prescription, and dental coverage under SEHBP/NJEHP (Chapter 44), employer Social Security/FICA, workers' compensation, and unused sick leave retirement reserves.
In-district special education teachers, paraprofessionals/instructional aides, Child Study Teams, speech/OT/PT therapy, and preschool disabled programs.
Mandated out-of-district private placements for students with severe disabilities plus tuition paid to Morris County Vocational School District (MCVSD) in Denville.

majorAppropriations.category: Plant Operations, Custodial, Utilities & School Security
majorAppropriations.details: Maintenance of 14 school buildings and athletic fields, custodial staff, Class III School Security Officers / SROs, HVAC upgrades, electricity, and natural gas.
District-operated and contracted school bus routes covering 25.4 square miles of Parsippany-Troy Hills, special education vans, and athletic transit.
Salaries for 14 school principals, assistant principals at the middle and high schools, athletic directors, and building secretaries.

majorAppropriations.category: Central Administration, Legal Challenge to PILOTs & Business Office
majorAppropriations.details: Superintendent's office (Dr. Karen Chase), Business Administrator (Robin Tedesco), HR, and special legal counsel retained by the BOE to challenge Township PILOT tax breaks that exclude public schools.
